column1: TABLE 7. The Mean and Overall Densities in Four Different Regions in the Human Cerebellum (10^3 mm^-3)^1

^1The mean and overall densities in units of 10^3 mm^-3 of the six cell types in four different regions in the human cerebellum. Mean and coefficient of variation (CV = SD/mean) between individuals are shown. Granule, Purkinje, and Golgi cells in granular layer and glial in granular cell layer have the granular layer as reference space. The overall density is the ratio of the total number of cells in the whole reference space divided by the volume of the whole reference space.
